build_plugin_layer: build a plugin layer from a config dict with type and layer args using mmengine MODELS registry
infer_abbr_from_class: infer an abbreviation string from a class type by checking the _abbr_ attribute or converting the class name to snake case
convert_camel_to_snake: convert a camel case class name like FancyBlock into snake case fancy_block using regex substitution
lookup_plugin_in_registry: lookup a plugin layer class by name string in the mmengine MODELS registry and return the class
create_named_plugin_layer: create a named plugin layer by combining an inferred abbreviation with a postfix and instantiating the layer with kwargs
